fullPassage: Adopting a growth mindset opens up a host of benefits that ripple through learning and life. First and foremost, it cultivates resilience. When setbacks occur — as they inevitably do — people with growth mindsets see them as temporary obstacles rather than proof of inadequacy. They tap into creativity to find new strategies and keep moving forward. This persistence often leads to greater achievement than raw talent ever could. Beyond resilience, a growth orientation encourages curiosity and experimentation. It turns mistakes from sources of shame into valuable feedback, fostering a spirit of continuous improvement. Not everyone bounces back from failure and setbacks can, for some, result in deep discouragement or even prevent them from rebuilding their resilience. And by valuing effort over outcome, individuals tend to maintain motivation longer, enjoying progress for its own sake rather than just external validation. * ripple through ~에 확산되다 ** resilience 회복력

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① cultivating → cultivates: 주어 it의 술어동사 자리에 현재분사가 올 수 없다
det.analysis:
✅ ① cultivating → cultivates: 'First and foremost, it ___ resilience' — 주어 it(= a growth mindset)에 대한 술어동사가 필요. 현재분사 cultivating은 술어동사 불가. 3인칭 단수 현재형 cultivates 필요 ←정답
❌ ② keep: 'They tap into creativity to find new strategies and keep moving forward' — keep + V-ing 구문으로 적절
❌ ③ fostering: 'into valuable feedback, fostering a spirit of ~' — 분사구문(동시 동작), 주절과 능동 관계 적절
❌ ④ rebuilding: 'prevent them from rebuilding their resilience' — prevent + O + from + V-ing 구문 적절
det.tip: 술어동사 vs 분사: 주어 + 술어동사(cultivates) / 콤마 + 분사구문(fostering)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ enjoyed → enjoying: 주절과 동시 동작을 나타내는 분사구문이므로 현재분사가 필요하다
det.analysis:
❌ ① Adopting: 동명사구 'Adopting a growth mindset'이 주어 역할, 단수 취급하여 opens와 수 일치 — 적절
❌ ② creativity: 'tap into creativity to find new strategies' — 명사 creativity(창의성)가 tap into의 목적어로 적절
✅ ③ enjoyed → enjoying: 'individuals tend to maintain motivation longer, ___ progress' — 주절과 동시 동작을 나타내는 분사구문. 주어가 능동으로 즐기는 관계이므로 현재분사 enjoying 필요 ←정답

det.tip: 분사구문: 주절과 동시 동작 + 능동 → V-ing (enjoying). enjoyed(과거형/수동)는 부적합

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: creativity(창의성): 새로운 전략을 찾고 계속 나아가기 위해 활용하는 것으로 창의성이 적절하다

det.tip: tap into = ~을 활용하다, ~에 접근하다

det.analysis:
✅ ① inadequacy(부적절함): 'temporary obstacles rather than proof of ___' — 좌절을 장애물로 보지, 자신이 부족하다는 증거로 보지 않음. rather than 구조에서 부정적 의미 필요 ←정답

❌ ④ improvement(개선): 'proof of improvement'는 긍정적 의미. 문맥상 좌절의 부정적 해석 필요

❌ ④ 노력보다 결과를 중시할 때 동기가 더 오래 유지된다: 본문은 'valuing effort over outcome' — 노력을 결과보다 가치 있게 여긴다고 함. 반대

questions.passage: Adopting a growth mindset opens up a host of benefits that ripple through learning and life. First and foremost, it cultivates resilience. When setbacks occur — as they inevitably do — people with growth mindsets see them as temporary obstacles rather than proof of inadequacy. They tap into creativity to find new strategies and keep moving forward. This persistence often leads to greater achievement than raw talent ever could. Beyond resilience, a growth orientation encourages curiosity and experimentation. It turns mistakes from sources of shame into valuable feedback, fostering a spirit of continuous improvement. Not everyone bounces back from failure and setbacks can, for some, result in deep discouragement or even prevent them from rebuilding their resilience. And by valuing effort over outcome, individuals tend to maintain motivation longer, enjoying progress for its own sake rather than just external validation.
